items.text: Kolot Abimelek okoku loka Yerubaal Sekem mama ejaas iinacan luka totoke, kiner kakes, ka ekek kere loka ekal loka papa loka totoke, atiar,

“Keŋaiŋaito, kinerata kaki kere nuka ituŋa luka Sekem ebe, ‘Arai kiiokikinito yes odwe kere luka Yerubaal luimwaasi ituŋa akaisakanykaarei, ayaite yes, arai bo ediopet ayaite yes?’ Kiitutu da ebe arai eoŋ akoitikus ka akirinikus.”
Kinerata iinaean luka totoke nuken aki kere nuka ituŋa luka Sekem akiro ŋun kere: kokotos ikecetauon atupar Abimelek; naarai abalas cbe, “Erai onacewok.”
Koinakis ŋul ŋes atutubeta akaisakanykaarei nuka epuesa nualemunete kotogo loka Baal-berit, nuabu Abimelek koropia ituŋa luutai luebenen, luatupito ŋes,
Kolot Opura ore loka papake, koarak ikeinacan odwe luka Yerubaal, luemwaasi ituŋa akaisakanykaarei, amoru adiopet: konye kideun Yotam eŋoorit loka Yerubaal; naarai abu konop.
Kotukokinos ituŋa kere luka Sekem, ka ekal kere loka Milo, koloto kitaraut Abimelek ekabaka, kaneedunyas kelua loka epir loajai Sekem,
Kelimokin Yotam nun, abu kodoka aibwo aidi naka moru Gcrisim, kodelo, kiworo, ko te ma kes atiar, “Kopupunoi, yes ituŋa luka Sekem, tetere Edeke kipupuni yes.
Kolosek apotu ikito koloto ainyonyoikin eka baka akinyet ayaite kes; kotemasi eseitun atiar, ‘Koyaai ijo sio.’
Konye kotema eseitun kes atiar, ‘Enyeini kereka eoŋ akinyeteka naitopolonorere Edeke ka ituŋanan, kasodi alosit aijaŋijaŋa kokito?’
Kotemasi ikito etini atiar,, Bia ijo koyaai sio.’
Konye kotema etini kes atiar, ‘Enyeini kereka eoŋ akaiiiim, ka araitoka nukajokak, kasodi alosit aijaŋijaŋa kokito?’
Kotemasi ikito emusabibu atiar, ‘Bia ijo, koyaai sio.’
Kotema emusabibu kes atiar, ‘Enyeini kereka ebinoka, loitalakarit Edeke ka ituŋanan, kasodi alosit aijaŋijaŋa kokito?’
Kosodete ikito kere atemar etirir atiar, ‘Bia ijo, koyaai sio.’
Kotema etirir ikito atiar, ‘Arai kinyonyoikinete yesi eoŋ akinyet kotoma abeit araun ekabakakus, kopotu do komunokinos etolimika: arai bo mam, kolom do akim kotirir, konyama iresia luka Lebanon.’
“Aso do, arai iswamato yesi kabeit ka nuetenito, aitaraun Abimelek eka baka, arai da iswamakinito yesi Yerubaal ka ekaleke nuejok, ido kiswamakinito ŋes kwape ibusakinitor nueswamat:
(Naarai abu papaka koiiik yes komam epod aijarake, koyu da yes kakan naka Midian:

Inyoutu do yesi lolo asurokin ekalloka papaka, iarakis odweke, ituŋa akaisakanykaarei, amoru adiopet, itarautu da Abimelek okoku loka abusiatake ekabaka loeyait ituŋa luka Sekem, naarai erai onacekus;)
Arai iswamakinito yesi Yerubaal ka ekaleke lolo nukabeit ka nuetenito, kolelata do yesi kotoma Abimelek, ŋesi da kolele kotomakus:
Konye arai mam, kolom do akim kotoma Abimelek, konyama ituŋa luka Sekem, ka ekalloka Milo; kolom da akim kotoma otuŋa luka Sekem, kotoma okal loka Milo, konyama Abimelek.”
Kosi Yotam, koker, kolot Beer, kiboi kaŋina, kanuka akurian Abimelek onaceke.
Kijuk Edeke emoyo loerono kidin Abimelek ka ituŋa luka Sekem; kiswamakis ituŋa luka Sekem Abimelek nuka aiŋal:

Tetere edolete nukadeden nuaponi kiswamakinai odwe akaisakanykaarei luka Yerubaal, tetere da itebeo aokotokee Abimelek onacekee, loaari kes, itebeo da ituŋa luka Sekem, luetogogonete akaninike aiar iinaeanake.
Kibwaikis ituŋa luka Sekem ikaperunok ŋes aidia nuka ironan, konatata kere luetorete orot ŋol: kolimokinai Abimelek,
Kobu Gaal okoku loka Ebed ka iinaeanake, koloto Sekem: komunokinos ŋes ituŋa luka Sekem.
Kolomasi omanikor, kodenoto imusabibunukee, kieakaeakata imusabibun, kipooto epueit, kolomasi togo loka edekekee, konyamata komatata, kikenoto Abimelek.

Kotema Gaal okoku loka Ebed atiar, “Iŋai bo Abimelek, iŋai da Sekem, tape sio kiiaanakini ŋes? Mere ŋes okoku loka Yerubaal? ka Sebul ekiyakiake? ijaanakinete yesi ituŋa luka Kamor papa loka Sekem: konye sio kanukinyo tikiiaanakinia ŋes?
Karai kejaas ituŋa lu akanika! Tikalema Abimelek.” Kotema ŋesi Abimelek atiar, “Kiyatak akonijore, kolom.”
Kepupu Sebul ekayaiton ere akiro nuka Gaal okoku loka Ebed, abu akenyunyura kinep.
Abu kijukak Abimelek ikiyakia kaiyeiyea ebe, “Koany, apotu Gaal okoku loka Ebed ka ikeinacan Sekem; ido koany, etinaikis ere asurokin joo
Aso do, konyou kuare, ijo ka ituŋa luejaas kajo, koperut kamanat:
Kosodi tupuruc, atipet naeniunia akoloŋ, kodilok ijo anyoun asurokin ere: ido koany, kelomut ŋesi kituna luejaas kaŋes asurokin jo, iswamakini do ijo kes kwape itojokia.”
Konyou Abimelek kuare, ka ituŋa kere luajaas kaŋes, koperut Sekem korioneta iwonon.
Koloma Gaal okoku loka Ebed, kobwo korute kaneelomarere ore: konyou Abimelek ka ituŋa kere luajaas kaŋes kaneaperunitotor.
Nakeanyunia Gaal ituŋa, kotema ŋesi Sebul atiar, “Koany, ijesuna ituŋa kaidia nuka ironan.” Kotema Sebul ŋes atiar, “Tseseni ijo etolim loka iroŋan kosubite bala ituŋa.”
Kinera Gaal bobo ebe, “Koany, ijesuna ituŋa kokidin kakwap, itorunit erioŋet ediopet orot loka elua loka Meonenim.”
Kosodi Sebul atemar ŋes atiar, “Ai bo kwana ejai aitukukon, naibalar ebe, “Tnai bo Abimelek, tape sio kijaanakini ŋes?’ Mere ŋul ituŋa luimwanit ijo? Kenainait, koloma cabo do kitiji kes.”
Koloma Gaal kakonyen nuka ituŋa luka Sekem, kitiji Abimelek.
Kodap Abimelek ŋes, koker kakonyeneke, kibiroros luipu luemusunitai, kiton neelomarere orute.
Kiboikin Abimelek Aruma: kirenea Sebul Gaal ka iinaeanake, kinyeis aiboi koSckem.
Kosodi kanen, kapaaran naatupakini kolomas ituŋa amanat; kolimokis kesi Abimelek.
Koyana ituŋa, kotiak kes kotoma orioneta iuni, koperut kamanat; kosesen, ido koany, kolomut ituŋa kore; konyou asurokin kes, kodany kes.
Kokubokinos Abimelek ka irioneta luajaas kaŋes, kobwaata korute kaneelomarere ore: kokerata irioneta iarei neajaas nul kere luajaas amanat, kodanyata kes.
Kitiji Abimelek ere apaaran ŋin kere; kirum ere, koar ituŋa luajaas toma; kotiyatiya ere, koyeik abalaij.
Kepuputu ituŋa kere lukore loeoja loka Sekem ŋun, apotu kolomasi abur nakotogo loka El-berit.
Kolimokinai Abimelek ebe etukokina ituŋa kere lukotogo loeoja loka Sekem.

Kodoka Abimelek moru Salumon, ŋes ka ituŋa kere luajaas kaŋes; kitin aep kakanike, kojep atenu kokito, kitin ŋes, kibwaik okeperike: kotema ituŋa luajaas kaŋes atiar, “Nuianyutu eoŋ eswamai, kisunyito yesi da, kiswamata kwape kwaŋin.”

Kosodete ituŋa kere aiepun ŋinituŋanan aketenut, kotupasi Abimelek, koganata kes abur, kinokokis akim aicweia abur; kotwakata do ituŋa kere lukotogo loeoja loka Sekem, kwape elukumit, ikiliok ka aŋor.
Kosodi Abimelek alosit Tebes, kidukur asurokin Tebes, kirum ŋes,
Konye ajai etogo loeoia loagogon toma ore, apotu ikiliok ka aŋor kere kokereasi nina, ka nul kere lukore, kogoloros kotoma, kodokasi oswi loka etogo loeoia.
Kobu Abimelek togo loeoja, kitiii ŋes, kikunyak okek loka etogo loeoia aicwe ŋes.
Abu aberu adiopet kocakak atapen akou naka Abimelek, kobwan abelekek naka akouke.
Kosodi ŋesi anyaraun katipet ekatumunan loadakit lujiisike, kotema ŋes atiar, “Kout ekilenikon koar eoŋ, kinyeis ituŋa atemar ebe, ‘Aberu aari ŋes.’’’ Kieum ekatumunanike ŋes aipelor, kotwana.
Keanyut ituŋa luka Isirael ebe atwana Abimelek, koloto ninituŋanan aiboisike.
Kwaŋin abu Edeke kinyan aronis naka Abimelek, naabu kiswamak papake, kanuka aiar iinaeanake akaisakanykaarei.
Aronis kere naka ituŋa luka Sekem abu Edeke kinyan kakwesikee: abu kobunok kes ekenit loka Yotam okoku loka Yerubaal.
